barrett-weapons.prompt:
Production sprite sheet for a hand-drawn pencil/crayon and black-ink side scrolling game. Preserve EXACT character in first reference, outfit, face, proportions, palette. Other references show the exact blaster and sword to hold. Generate ONE wide sheet with EXACTLY 32 complete full-body poses, regular EIGHT columns by FOUR rows. True transparent background, generous empty gutters, NO background wash, grid lines, labels, floor, or text other than existing costume markings. No clipped hair, weapons, hands or feet. All poses face RIGHT, same body scale. Row1: EIGHT-frame chronological running cycle HOLDING THE BLASTER: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up. Row2: still holding blaster, columns1-4 jump takeoff/rise/apex/fall, column5 upright idle with blaster aimed right, columns6-8 aim/firing recoil/recovery. Row3: EIGHT-frame running cycle HOLDING THE FLAME SWORD instead, same pose order. Row4: sword jump takeoff/rise/apex/fall, upright idle holding sword UPRIGHT, slash anticipation/full forward slash/recovery. Both weapons MUST be gripped in the same RIGHT hand in every respective pose, fingers wrap around grip, hand and weapon drawn together. Sword robust broad blade at least torso-length, silver/red blade, red handle and small warm flames around guard like reference. Blaster white housing, lime cylinder and orange grip as reference, NO rockets/launcher/extra weapons. Sword never present in blaster rows, blaster never present in sword rows. Run with energetic alternating legs; weapon stays firmly gripped, free arm counter-swings. Single consistent camera and scale, clean isolated complete silhouettes safely within every slot.
Brown spiky hair, orange eyes, massive furry brown bear forearms and claws, torn red sleeveless hoodie, dark torn jeans, red sneakers. Do NOT turn him into an actual bear. Grip weapon securely with the bear hand.
